verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents recovery when a pipeline breaks: a dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker lets failed events be replayed instead of lost, Kafka buffers data while a warehouse is in maintenance and delivers it once the warehouse is back, and resent data is deduplicated. Nothing in the evidence shows replaying archived history into a newly added destination. Missing for 10: replay or backfill of archived events into a new destination, documented replay controls such as time ranges and target selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
